title: Jaguars stunned by Giants amid officiating controversy, questionable late-game decision from head coach Liam Coen

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Jaguars stunned by Giants amid officiating controversy, questionable late-game decision from head coach Liam Coen
sources.description: Plagued by red zone woes, officiating controversy and a questionable late-game decision by Liam Coen, the Jaguars fell 23-18 to the Giants.
